end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying the starting value and the amount added each round, then writing rules such as 5n + 3. Reyansh found the 10th term as 53 and corrected the initial idea “n + 5” by including the starting value. They also checked that 200 did not belong when solving gave a non-whole-number position. At home, practise making a small table of term number and value before writing the rule.
